name: flash-wake-on-input
title: Wake Storage on Input
summary: A button press starts the flash storage at once.
description: Starts the flash storage when you press a button, so that the first song starts sooner.
details: After a long pause, a button press starts the storage immediately.
Thus the storage is ready when you choose a song.
After a start, the iPod does not examine the storage again for 30 minutes.
A turn of the click wheel does not start the storage.
requires: Flash storage, for example an iFlash, CompactFlash or SSD adapter. Do not use this patch with the original hard drive.
notes: Use this patch together with SSD Mode if the first song after a long pause starts late.
hdd_warning: This patch is for flash storage. On the original hard drive, each button press after a long pause starts the disk, and the disk turns for 30 minutes. This uses more battery and causes more wear.
